title: Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: Grilled lamb kebabs infused with the flavors of Syria, perfect for a hearty dinner. This recipe uses a mixture of spices and herbs to create a delicious and aromatic dish.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together oregano, paprika, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked through.
Transfer the kebabs to a serving platter and garnish with thinly sliced yellowed onion.
Serve hot with additional lemon wedges, if desired.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
